title: Emmy Awards begin as 'Widow's Bay' and 'The Pitt' vie for top prizes
summary: The Emmy Awards kicked off Monday in Los Angeles to celebrate television's brightest stars, with horror-comedy series "Widow's Bay" and gritty hospital drama "The Pitt" expecting to win big.
